methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched directly from each vendor's official pricing or product page via WebFetch on 2026-06-14. ElevenLabs: elevenlabs.io/pricing — page rendered with full plan data. Murf.ai: murf.ai/pricing returned JS-only blank page; pricing sourced from murf.ai/text-to-speech product page which displays annual rates. WellSaid Labs: wellsaidlabs.com/pricing redirects to wellsaid.io/pricing — full data retrieved. Resemble AI: resemble.ai/pricing returned full pay-as-you-go rate card. Speechify: speechify.com/pricing rendered plan names and monthly price; annual rate only partially visible ('SAVE 60%'); sourceforge.net corroboration confirmed $139/year. Amazon Polly: aws.amazon.com/polly/pricing — full per-character rate card retrieved. Play.ht: play.ht domain refused all connections (ECONNREFUSED); multiple aggregator and review URLs also failed or returned 403/404; only a starting price of $29/mo was found in a secondary review article (elegantthemes.com) — insufficient to include with verified tier structure, excluded from dataset. monthlyUsd for usage-metered plans with no flat subscription is set to null (Resemble Flex, Amazon Polly). annualDiscountPct computed where both monthly and annual rates are confirmed.
